title: Bloom Filter
description: Write a Zig program that implements a simple Bloom filter for set membership testing.
hints: A Bloom filter uses multiple hash functions to set bits in a bit array
`@truncate(u6)` converts a u64 hash to a 6-bit value (0-63)
`mightContain` returns false when definitely absent, true when possibly present
